text_1981: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious,
text_ref: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

text_1981: Read, in the name of your Lord, who created.*
footnote_1981: *96:1-19 From 96 to 114 is 19 suras. The first revelation (96:1-5) is 19 Arabic words, 76 letters (19x4). The sura consists of 19 verses and 304 Arabic letters (App. 1 & 23).
text_1989: Read, in the name of your Lord, who created.*

text_ref: Read, in the name of your Lord, who created.*

text_1981: He created man from an embryo.
text_1989: He created man from an embryo.
text_ref: He created man from an embryo.

text_1981: Read, and your Lord, Most Exalted.
text_1989: Read, and your Lord, Most Exalted.
text_ref: Read, and your Lord, Most Exalted.

text_1981: Teaches by means of the pen.
text_1989: Teaches by means of the pen.
text_ref: Teaches by means of the pen.

text_1981: He teaches man what he never knew.
text_1989: He teaches man what he never knew
text_ref: He teaches man what he never knew.

text_1981: Indeed, the human transgresses.
text_1989: Indeed, the human transgresses.
text_ref: Indeed, the human transgresses.

text_1981: When he becomes rich.
text_1989: When he becomes rich.
text_ref: When he becomes rich.

text_1981: To your Lord is the ultimate destiny.
text_1989: To your Lord is the ultimate destiny.
text_ref: To your Lord is the ultimate destiny.

text_1981: Have you seen the one who enjoins.
text_1989: Have you seen the one who enjoins.
text_ref: Have you seen the one who enjoins.

text_1981: Others from praying?
text_1989: Others from praying?
text_ref: Others from praying?

text_1981: Is it not better for him to follow the guidance?
text_1989: Is it not better for him to follow the guidance?
text_ref: Is it not better for him to follow the guidance?

text_1981: Or advocate righteousness?
text_1989: Or advocate righteousness?
text_ref: Or advocate righteousness?

text_1981: If he disbelieves and turns away.
text_1989: If he disbelieves and turns away.
text_ref: If he disbelieves and turns away.

text_1981: Does he not realize that GOD sees?
text_1989: Does he not realize that GOD sees?
text_ref: Does he not realize that GOD sees?

text_1981: Indeed, unless he refrains, we will take him by the forelock.
text_1989: Indeed, unless he refrains, we will take him by the forelock.
text_ref: Indeed, unless he refrains, we will take him by the forelock.

text_1981: A forelock that is disbelieving and sinful.
text_1989: A forelock that is disbelieving and sinful.
text_ref: A forelock that is disbelieving and sinful.

text_1981: Let him then call on his helpers.
text_1989: Let him then call on his helpers.
text_ref: Let him then call on his helpers.

text_1981: We will call the guardians of Hell.
text_1989: We will call the guardians of Hell.
text_ref: We will call the guardians of Hell.

text_1981: You shall not obey him; you shall fall prostrate and draw nearer.
text_1989: You shall not obey him; you shall fall prostrate and draw nearer.
text_ref: You shall not obey him; you shall fall prostrate and draw nearer.
